name: better-accessibility
title_zh: 自动扫出对比度不足的按钮和表单标签
tagline_zh: 开发时总被测试提无障碍 bug？装它，提交前自动检查对比度、焦点顺序和 ARIA 标注，直接告诉你哪个组件不达标。
tagline_en: Tired of a11y bugs from QA? Scan your code pre-commit for contrast, focus order, and ARIA issues, with exact.
desc_en: Helps your project comply with accessibility standards and best practices.
why_zh: 不是泛泛的规则清单，而是针对你项目实际 DOM 结构做检查，能指出具体元素和修复建议。
why_en: Not a generic checklist—it inspects your actual DOM structure, pinpoints offending elements, and suggests concrete fixes, saving.
limit_zh: 只检查前端代码中的可访问性静态问题，不覆盖动态交互和屏幕阅读器实测；需要项目已有可运行的构建环境。
limit_en: Static front-end checks only; no dynamic interaction or real screen-reader testing. Needs a runnable build; useless for design files or backends.
title_en: Auto-check contrast and labels for buttons and forms
